environment.note: Same machine, sequential runs, native forward/reverse scrolling; developer preview. CPU values measure JS render submission, not GPU duration.

decision: Enable prepared-path mode by default: reproducible reduction in render CPU and frame intervals, same particle count, viewport and DPR. Baseline retained behind query flag.
limitations: Not an all-device FPS guarantee. Input-to-display latency was not directly measured; the repeated native-scroll run measures rAF intervals and long frames.

source.scope: Original portfolio measurements; not a benchmark of the extracted kolam package.
